I want to leave this company and start my own work as I do not feel my Iman each time so strong that I may be able to violate the cultures of the company which are not according to sharia like wearing pent shirt, Answering greetings of Na Maharam.Also things like the mendatory insurance component in the salary which I do not want to subscribe for, still deducted from my salary. In short these and some other things inspire me to start my own job.My parents have taken loan from bank.The loan includes interest terms also..Allah helps them to repay the loan via me.(However I am not the only source but Allah has made me as a major contributor towards repayment of the loan). Is this okay If I ask My parents to give me few months (2-3) to collect money by the salary instead of giving them and made investment in new work? However I have talked already to my parents about it that this new work may require some investment of a good portion of 2-3 months salary and they have given there consent. Learning means any learning what people may put on the website.Hence this learning can be according to sharia and opposite to sharia also. So the second question is such service/website allowed. The third question is about charging the people who use this service. Someone may be allowed to pay amount(as a fees of using this website) if He/She feels that he/she has benefitted via this website. So its upto that "Somebody" whether he wants to pay for the use website or not. Is such earning halal,(Please let me know even if its halal but undesirable)? Also should I set a maximum amount which a person can pay if he/she wills to pay? answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 64116 Country: India Title: What is the ruling regarding taking photos from such an angle that the face of a person or a living being is not captured? Question: What is the ruling regarding taking photos from such an angle that the face of a person or a living being is not captured? Answer ID: 64116 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 760/750/L=07/1437) If the picture of some person or animal is taken in such an angle that the face is not captured then it shall be like the picture of tree etc and shall not be among the haram pictures. And the person who takes such a picture shall not qualify the warning of one who makes picture of living being as it is clear in the hadith of Nasai. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
